tools_helpful.evidence: build-output.txt: 5 distinct WUI0004 warnings pinpointed every UWP-only GetForCurrentView() call site (InputPane in Scenario2/Scenario3, CoreInputView in Scenario4).

tool_limitations.limitation: The generic GetForCurrentView() inventory entry routed all call sites to the #getforcurrentview anchor, but that anchor's replacement table had no InputPane/CoreInputView row, so the agent reached correct guidance that was incomplete.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Complete the GetForCurrentView replacement table so every routed API has a concrete target.

failed_apis.why_tried: Straight port of UWP touch-keyboard show/hide event + TryShow/TryHide code.
failed_apis.root_cause: GetForCurrentView() has no per-view singleton in WinUI 3 desktop; it returns null/throws, so the ported call is a runtime no-op.

failed_apis.why_tried: Straight port of UWP emoji-keyboard trigger.
failed_apis.root_cause: CoreInputView has no *Interop.GetForWindow, and GetForUIContext needs a Windows.UI.UIContext that WinUI 3 elements no longer expose (UIElement.UIContext absent) — no supported desktop path.
failed_apis.fix: Accept as a known limitation and drop the dead call; do not silence it with an empty try/catch.

doc_errors.correct: Also needs InputPane (-> InputPaneInterop.GetForWindow) and CoreInputView (no supported path).

doc_errors.wrong: Symptom/fix framed only around SystemNavigationManager back-button; implies a single API.
doc_errors.correct: WUI0004 fires for any *.GetForCurrentView() (InputPane, CoreInputView, DisplayInformation, etc.); fix is the interop mapping, not a back-button drop.

special_apis.special_handling: View-bound UWP input surfaces; InputPane maps to HWND interop, CoreInputView has no desktop equivalent.

errors_encountered.error: warning WUI0004: InputPane.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only (Scenario2 x2, Scenario3 x2)

errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP view-bound API with no desktop equivalent left unported.
errors_encountered.fix: Accept limitation; remove the dead call.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Every GetForCurrentView() call was wrapped in an empty try { ... } catch { } that swallows the runtime failure.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The skill routed the agent to #getforcurrentview but the table had no InputPane/CoreInputView row, so the agent defensively swallowed the exception to keep the build green.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — feature compiles with WUI0004 and silently no-ops at runtime.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding InputPane/CoreInputView rows to the replacement table plus an explicit 'do not silence WUI0004 with empty try/catch' rule.

env_issues.workaround: Score verified structure via UIA tree + source; capture limitation is in the eval tooling, out of migration-skill scope.
